project.name: Demo Room
project.summary: A small demo scene with five placeholder objects the user can point at while talking to the assistant. Object descriptions are intentionally sparse so you can practice the update_object flow.

objects.name: Object 1
objects.summary: A first object in the demo scene.
objects.content: This is a placeholder object in the demo scene. It has no content or geometry, but it can be used to practice the update_object flow. The user can point at this object while talking to the assistant, and the assistant can respond with information about the object.
